drafted_from: the old server's publishTool/unpublishTool at b6ae0ebf815f (src/workshop.mjs:1686, 1793), ported as tool:unpublish-tool
start_here: Say to your AI: "Take my listing of tool:echo-test back out."
no_lists_because: A listing is one row of the marketplace_listings table in the database the person names (the tool makes that table on first use), not a row of a list, so there is no list for a person to keep or pour into.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI which tool to take back and the maker's name, with the database it is listed in.
2. Read the answer: the evidence (status withdrawn, the maker, the fingerprint and the times). The body is removed; the evidence stays.
3. A tool you did not publish cannot be withdrawn by you; a refusal says so.

worked_examples.title: Unpublish a tool
worked_examples.ask: Save this tool so I can find it later: it echoes text back.

input.database: the database the listing is in

worked_examples.given: Publish or withdraw tool:echo-test for this maker
worked_examples.hands_back: The evidence: tool_id "tool:echo-test", status "withdrawn", with its fingerprint and times; the body is gone.
